opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a crypto earnings program while assuring viewers that it involves “Zero Risk.” It identifies Forsage as “a multi-level marketing scheme” and states that “They need a team is required for” participation. The instructions go further, telling participants, “We have to include the people who believe in us in their team,” making recruitment central to the opportunity rather than merely explaining blockchain technology. The process is also tied to affiliate participation, as the narration states, “It is run using the Affiliate link.” These assurances and recruitment instructions actively encourage viewers to register, select slots, and participate in a tiered earning structure.
